impact: runCrossReview sends the entire diff in one turn — a diff large enough to need chunking in the main review will likely fail the adjudication turn. runAdjudicate swallows any failure into all-undefined adjudications, so "deliberate-deep ran but adjudication failed" is indistinguishable from findings that were never adjudicated. MARKER HALF DONE (T-028): runAdjudicate/adjudicateDivergent now surface per-judge failures as deliberation.cross_review_failures[], distinguishing "could not run" from "ran, found nothing". REMAINING (T-030): chunk/slice the cross-review subject so a large diff doesn't blow the adjudication turn.
title: Cross-review round is unchunked and its failure is invisible
